description_en: Queries workspaces under the current tenant with paging. The list does not return soft-deleted records with a status of Deleted by default. Results are stably sorted by creation order on the server side
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的工作空间。列表默认不返回状态为 Deleted 的软删除记录，结果按创建顺序由服务端稳定排序
name: ListWorkspaces

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of workspaces to skip
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page
parameters.name: next_token
